authorization: Owner 2026-10-26: targets 1/2/3/5/7/10 wick R and initial-stop optimization; explicitly selected limit entry, fixed percentage protection before touch close.
slippage: Separate arithmetic debit on every taker exit, matching current paper convention; fee BE itself offsets commission only.
source: Frozen 632 crypto cohorts and matched native limit fills. Binance historical OHLC; OKX account fee rates. No downloads or hashes.
scope: All first-touch 5m confirmation opportunities; altcoins primary, BTC/ETH separate. No score threshold/filter is selected or fitted.
entry: Reuse native actual first weekly-side resting limit fills. All filled attempts retained, including failed confirmations, non-wick bodies and stops before R becomes known.
r: At complete touch-5m close: level to low for long, high to level for short (actual fill level rounding preserved); undefined/zero R keeps no TP and still follows confirmation/stop, never filtered by future geometry.
target_activation: Only at touch5m close. Marketable newly installed target exits at that close as taker, otherwise resting maker TP.
initial_stop: Fixed percent from fill remains until confirmation; R normalizes targets and outcomes, not pre-fill sizing.
confirm: Immediate next5m CLOSE strictly inside actual entry; failed closes exit as taker. Success first installs exact-entry protection, then fee-inclusive stop only at a completed close beyond fee price.
fee_breakeven: Long E*(1+maker)/(1-taker); short E*(1-maker)/(1+taker). Native gap execution may lose; delayed entry stop loses fees. Never count fee BE as a substantive win.
path: VectorBT native OHLC stop-first when both barriers touched, observed open precedes extremes. New close decisions apply after that close only.
engine: VectorBT1.2.0 native ohlc_stop_choice_nb/get_stop_price_nb and Portfolio.from_orders; independent columns; no second-framework replay.
controls: Original3 random submissions matched on symbol/NYweek/direction/causal prior14bar volatility bucket. Own completed touch candle defines their R. Keep unfilled attempts in original ledger; conditional complete1+3 comparison.
selection: Maximize mean equal-notional net return after separate10bp slippage in2025; check2026; show full-history optimum descriptively; all historical segments previously exposed.
boundaries: Missing source bar/data end censors, never win/loss. Known BABY/DASH corrupt touch pairs excluded and their bars break active paths.
